items.label: Size
items.value: Measuring 9.8"L x 3.9"W x 7.5"H (25×10×19cm), Undetachable Shoulder Strap Drop: Adjustable to two lengths (10.7" / 27cm OR 19.7" / 50cm). This handmade woven purse for a sleek yet spacious profile.

items.label: Premium Crafted & Stylish
items.value: Made from soft, durable PU leather and featuring high-quality, fade-resistant hardware, this bag is built to last. Its chic woven design elevates any outfit, from casual to dressy.

items.label: Optimized Interior
items.value: Includes 2 compartments, 1 zip pocket, 1 slip pocket. The magnetic snap closure provides quick. Separate your belongings logically and enjoy stress-free retrieval anytime.

items.label: Versatile Styling
items.value: Transform this bag into a top-handle bag, shoulder bag, or crossbody bag. Perfect for work, dates, parties, or travel—an ideal gift for any occasion.

items.label: Your Daily Essential Companion
items.value: Effortlessly combines style with function. Designed to carry your everyday must-haves: Easily store small e-reader, phone, wallet, cosmetics, sunglasses, keys, and more.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Spot clean with a damp cloth. Avoid excessive moisture and heat.
